checkedOccurrences.textualBasisJa: They traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.
The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,
Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;
Moses did as the LORD commanded. They went up onto Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. The soul of the people was very discouraged because of the journey.
They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.
They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.

wikipediaActualRead.identityBasisJa: 記事は聖書に二つの異なるホル山があると区別し、Edom節をこの南側の山として扱う。ただし記事も正確な位置は議論があると述べる。

geographyAssessmentJa: 山脈・山の候補として保持するが、Edom側Mount Horの位置は論争があり、代表候補とラベル表示。プロフィール座標はnull。
